annotations.title: US Business Entity Search: Colorado, Connecticut, New York

description: Look up US companies in official state business registers (Colorado, Connecticut, New York) or list newly formed entities by date: legal name, entity type, status, formation date, state of formation and city, with the source dataset. Official open data, one schema. Company level only: no registered agents, owners, officers, e-mail addresses or street addresses; trade names and sole proprietorships are excluded. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

entityType.description: Filter by entity type text (for example LLC, Corporation, DLLC).

formedSince.description: Only entities formed or registered on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use the date of your last run for new formations.

formedUntil.description: Only entities formed or registered on or before this date.

limit.description: Maximum entities per state. Each returned entity is one billable result.

name.description: Part of the legal name (at least 3 characters).

states.description: States to search: CO, CT, NY. Default: all three.

status.description: Filter by status (for example Active, Good Standing, Delinquent). New York lists active entities only.
